Remark
[Bounded mean oscillation] ↗ thm:poincares-inequality-ball 1. ch5:5.8-rem-1\group Poincaré Inequalities

If $u \in W^{1,n}(\R ^n) \cap L^1(\R ^n)$ and $B(x,r)$ is a ball, then \[ \int _{B(x,r)} |u - (u)_{x,r}|\, dy \le Cr\int _{B(x,r)} |Du|\, dy \] \[ \le Cr \left(\int _{B(x,r)} |Du|^n\, dy\right)^{1/n} \le C\left(\int _{\R ^n} |Du|^n\, dy\right)^{1/n}. \] Thus $u \in BMO(\R ^n)$, with seminorm \[ [u]_{BMO(\R ^n)} := \sup _{B(x,r) \subset \R ^n} \left\{ \int _{B(x,r)} |u - (u)_{x,r}|\, dy\right\} . \] See Stein \cite{Stein1993} for the theory of $BMO$.
